It is a federal district and the seat of the U.S. government, home to important landmarks like the White House, the U.S. Capitol, and the Supreme Court. Washington, D.C. was named after George Washington, the first president of the United States, and it became the capital in 1800, replacing New York City, which was the original capital. The city is also known for its museums, monuments, and historical significance. It is a unique city because it is not part of any state
